newsitem.title: UK: Celltech, Schering Plough test asthma drug.
newsitem.headline: Celltech, Schering Plough test asthma drug.

text.p: British drug discovery company Celltech Group Plc said on Wednesday that Schering Plough Corp of the U.S. was to go ahead with clinical trials on a joint asthma drug.

The project, involving a novel human antibody which the companies believe could be useful in asthma and other allergic diseases, has been held up for some time over safety concerns, leading some analysts to believe that it could be dropped.
But in its results statement Celltech said the U.S. company had told it that a European clinical trial "should start in the second half of 1997."
